title: SARS-CoV-2 entry route impacts a range of downstream viral and cellular processes
authors: Qu B; Miskey C; Gömer A; Potmus D; Nocke M; Kleinert RD; Itotia TK; Valder L; Brückmann J; Höck S; Hastert FD; von Rhein C; Schürmann C; Ebenig A; Widera M; Ciesek S; Pfaender S; Ivics Z; Schnierle BS; Tarr AW; Goffinet C; Mühlebach MD; Todt D; Brown RJ
one_liner_zh: 该文研究SARS-CoV-2进入途径对病毒复制和宿主免疫的影响，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: SARS-CoV-2 entry is promoted by both cell-surface TMPRSS2 and endolysosomal cathepsins. To investigate the impact of differentially routed virions on host and viral processes, lung epithelial cells expressing distinct combinations of entry factors were infected with authentic viruses. Entry route determined early rates of viral replication and transcription, egress and inhibitor sensitivity, with differences observed between virus strains. Transcriptional profiling revealed that induction of innate immunity was correlated to viral genome and transcript abundance in infected cells. Surface entry triggered early activation of antiviral responses, reducing cumulative virion production, while endolysosomal entry delayed antiviral responses and prolonged virus shedding due to extended cell viability. The likely molecular footprints of escape from antiviral effector targeting were also recorded in viral genomes and correlated with entry route-dependent immune status of cells. TMPRSS2 orthologues from diverse mammals, but not zebra fish, facilitated infection enhancement, which was more pronounced for ancestral strains. Leveraging RNA-seq and scRNA-seq datasets from SARS-CoV-2 infected hamsters, we validate aspects of our model in vivo . In summary, we demonstrate that distinct cellular and viral processes are linked to viral entry route, collectively modulating virus shedding, cell-death rates and viral genome evolution.
abstract_zh: SARS-CoV-2的入侵由细胞表面的TMPRSS2和内体溶酶体组织蛋白酶共同促进。为研究不同路径运输的病毒颗粒对宿主及病毒过程的影响，我们使用表达不同组合入侵因子的肺上皮细胞感染了真实病毒。入侵路径决定了病毒复制和转录的早期速率、释放及抑制剂敏感性，且不同病毒株间存在差异。转录谱分析显示，先天免疫的诱导与感染细胞中病毒基因组和转录本的丰度相关。表面入侵触发早期抗病毒反应，减少累积病毒颗粒产生，而内体溶酶体入侵则延迟抗病毒反应，并通过延长细胞存活时间而延长病毒释放。病毒基因组中还记录了逃避抗病毒效应物靶向的可能分子足迹，这些足迹与入侵路径依赖的细胞免疫状态相关。来自多种哺乳动物（而非斑马鱼）的TMPRSS2直系同源物促进了感染增强，且对祖先株更为显著。利用SARS-CoV-2感染仓鼠的RNA-seq和scRNA-seq数据集，我们在体内验证了模型的多个方面。总之，我们证明不同的细胞和病毒过程与病毒入侵路径相关，共同调节病毒释放、细胞死亡速率及病毒基因组进化。
